prediction.headline: No clear direction yet: the desk expects movement but cannot tell which way

why: NIFTY is at 25,709, down 175 points (-0.68%) from yesterday's close of 25,884.
This morning it opened 45 points lower than yesterday's close and has fallen 130 points since.
India VIX, the market's 'fear gauge', is 16.7. That points to a normal, lively market: NIFTY could move about 271 points up or down over the whole day.
In the last hour our news readers found 2 strong headlines: 2 good and 0 bad for the market.
Big news for the whole market today: Crude oil price rises on reports of Houthi attack on Saudi refinery.
Also: our forecast team's view is positive and the morning news brief reads the mood as mixed.
NIFTY has not moved enough this morning (less than about 0.15%) to pick a side.
plan: At 10:00 the desk buys two contracts on NIFTY for this week: a call, which makes money if NIFTY rises, and a put, which makes money if it falls. A big enough move either way pays more than the two cost together. It does not tilt the pair either way. It takes profit at +50%, cuts the loss at -35%, and closes everything by 15:15. All trades are on paper.
